nodes.label: Public REST API (v1)
nodes.rationale: Trigger-and-fetch only: workflows are created in the visual UI; the public /v1 surface and the internal /api JWT surface are intentionally independent.

nodes.label: API Key Authentication
nodes.rationale: Plaintext sk_live_ key shown once, only its SHA-256 hash stored; keys cannot be minted or revoked through the public API, so a leaked key cannot escalate to mint more keys. Revocation is immediate.

nodes.label: Idempotency Keys
nodes.rationale: Retrying POST /v1/workflows/:id/runs with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original run instead of triggering a duplicate; reusing a key against a different workflow is a 409 so mistakes fail loudly.

nodes.label: Cursor Pagination
nodes.rationale: Cursor-based, never offset-based, so pages do not shift when new runs appear; limit 1-100, default 20.

nodes.label: Consistent Error Shape
nodes.rationale: Every error on every endpoint shares one shape with a request_id; not_found / no_data never distinguish 'does not exist' from 'is not yours' to avoid leaking resource existence.

nodes.label: run.changed Event
nodes.rationale: Fires when a workflow with change monitoring enabled produces data differing from its previous run; payload adds a changes object with the diff summary alongside run. See PLATFORM_ANALYSIS 6.5.

nodes.label: Webhook Signature Verification (HMAC-SHA256)
nodes.rationale: v1 = HMAC_SHA256(secret, t + '.' + raw body) with a 300s replay-tolerance window; HMAC computed over raw body bytes before JSON parsing.

nodes.label: Usage & Quota Metering
nodes.rationale: Only API-triggered runs are metered; runs_quota null means unlimited.

nodes.label: apiWorker (async execution)
nodes.rationale: The DB is the queue: POST /runs only inserts a queued runs row; apiWorker claims it with an atomic conditional UPDATE (same pattern as the scheduler), no Redis. Race-safe across processes, so it can later move to a dedicated process or BullMQ as a pure deployment change.

nodes.label: Execution Pipeline (shared with API)
nodes.rationale: API-triggered runs go through the exact same pipeline as UI and scheduled runs, so self-healing, workflow versioning, and run history all apply.

nodes.label: needs_review Run Status
nodes.rationale: Means the run finished but self-healing left something for a human; partial data may still be available via /data.

nodes.label: Execution Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Persisted runs, error classification, staged self-healing with deterministic verification, auto-adopt policy, versioned rollback; positioned as ahead of Browse AI's 'robots that adapt' in transparency.

nodes.label: Self-healing
nodes.rationale: Empty-result detection, snapshot-verified fixes, confidence-gated auto-adopt, one-click manual adopt, full audit trail in run_repairs; a competitive differentiator.

nodes.label: API Discovery
nodes.rationale: Passively capture XHR/fetch, propose the site's underlying JSON API, replay-verify, and emit an EXTRACT_API step instead of scraping the DOM; a differentiator neither competitor ships.

nodes.label: Code Export (Puppeteer)
nodes.rationale: Download a standalone Puppeteer script plus tailored README; the 'no lock-in' differentiator (your scraper exports as runnable code).

nodes.label: Quick Scrape Wizard
nodes.rationale: One-button guided list scraping chaining navigate -> container detection -> AI field proposal -> pagination into one linear flow, then hands finished steps to the editor (QuickScrapeWizard.jsx).

nodes.label: Dashboard Home
nodes.rationale: Post-login landing with per-workflow status cards, a needs-attention inbox with AI summaries, schedule/next-run, and change indicators (Dashboard.jsx).

nodes.label: No-code Condition Builder
nodes.rationale: Field/operator/value dropdowns compiling to JS with 'edit as code' preserved, wired for IF / WHILE expressions (ConditionBuilder.jsx).

nodes.label: Scheduling (interval + time-of-day)
nodes.rationale: Partial: interval + time-of-day anchor (ScheduleEditor.jsx); no cron and no weekday selection yet.

nodes.label: Cross-run Dataset View
nodes.rationale: Rows unioned and de-duplicated across a workflow's retained successful runs with first/last-seen and times-seen; computed on read, so it works retroactively with no new storage (dataset.service.js, DatasetPanel.jsx).

nodes.label: Excel (.xlsx) Export
nodes.rationale: xlsx workbook with one worksheet per output list from run results and datasets; JSON/CSV also supported (resultsXlsx.js).

nodes.label: CSV Export (shared header-union serialiser)
nodes.rationale: A single header-union serialiser (resultsExport.js) takes headers from the union of all rows, not row 0 only, so columns missing from the first row are not dropped; the frontend shares it with a parity test that fails the build if the two ever drift. Powers both the in-app download and GET /v1/runs/:id/data?format=csv.

nodes.label: Change Monitoring & Alerts
nodes.rationale: Per-workflow 'watch for changes': after each successful run, row-level diff (add/remove/change) vs the previous run, keyed the same way the dataset view dedupes; store the summary on the run and fire run.changed through the webhook dispatcher. Change feed on dashboard, run history, and monitor editor. Email delivery still future (changeDiff.service.js, changeMonitor.service.js, MonitorEditor.jsx).

nodes.label: Webhooks (dispatcher + events)
nodes.rationale: Dispatcher + API + three events (run.completed / run.failed / run.changed); partial because there is still no UI to register/manage them.

nodes.label: Run History & Versioning
nodes.rationale: Every run pins the executed version; one-click rollback; logs, repairs, and AI summaries retained.

nodes.label: Pagination Handling
nodes.rationale: Three native containers (scroll/button/URL) plus a two-phase detector (static DOM scan + empirical scroll test) with confidence scores.

nodes.label: AI Field Suggestion
nodes.rationale: LLM proposal + live-DOM verification + heuristic fallback + intent-rescue merging; degrades gracefully with no API key.

nodes.label: Public REST API (feature inventory)
nodes.rationale: /v1 with hashed API keys, idempotency, cursor pagination, rate limits, quotas, signed webhooks, and a consistent error shape; matches the competitor API concept.

nodes.label: Prioritized Roadmap (P0-P3)
nodes.rationale: P0 correctness & production hygiene and P1 non-technical breakthrough are done; P2 competitive parity mostly done; P3 power-user polish open. Document doubles as the roadmap, marked shipped / partial / open.

nodes.label: Template Gallery (open)
nodes.rationale: Ship 6-10 saved workflows as JSON seeds plus a 'start from template' flow; cheap once workflow export/import exists because templates are the same JSON.

nodes.label: Workflow Export/Import/Duplicate (open)
nodes.rationale: Needed for backup, sharing, start-from-a-copy, and as the substrate for templates.

nodes.label: Webhook Management UI (open)
nodes.rationale: Today only POST /v1/webhooks registers one; there is no UI to list/manage endpoints.

nodes.label: Google Sheets Delivery (open)
nodes.rationale: Live push to Sheets still open; the webhook-dispatcher path is the right attachment point. Excel covers the offline case.

nodes.label: Bulk Input Lists (open)
nodes.rationale: First-class 'input list': paste/upload a CSV of URLs/terms, run once per row, tag results with the input. The variables + /v1 inputs plumbing exists; this is a UI plus a loop in the pipeline caller.

nodes.label: Cron / Weekday Scheduling (open)
nodes.rationale: Schedules are interval + time-of-day only; cron and weekday selection are open.
